overreach: a shift toward higher-speed connectivity, power/thermal infrastructure, resilience, high-speed interconnects, and production-oriented wireless validation in AI data-center contexts
signaling/non-signaling tester planning should account for high-speed digital I/O and adjacent SI/PCB validation rather than only RF behavior

Because AI data-center sources emphasize Connectivity and Wi-Fi 7 raises bandwidth, MIMO, modulation, and MLO demands, signaling testers such as CMX500 need multi-technology, multi-channel, cellular/WLAN, MLO/MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER, and E2E coverage

Because AI data-center sources point to high-speed connectivity, power infrastructure, and production ecosystems, non-signaling production testers should emphasize fast non-signaling RF, wide bandwidth, scalable MIMO, reference synchronization, and industrial EMC-conformant deployment
review.reason: The cited passages support the listed AI data-center ecosystem items and the CMX500/CMP180 capabilities, but they do not establish that AI data-center technology changes create Wi-Fi 7/cellular signaling or non-signaling tester requirements. Several key causal conclusions about required measurement capability are synthesized beyond the evidence rather than fairly grounded in the passages.
